brand.name: BadgeLane
brand.tagline: Swim school management that bills itself and tracks every badge.

metadata.title: BadgeLane
metadata.description: Class scheduling, skill-based progress tracking and automatic recurring billing for swim schools.

landing.heading: Run your swim school without chasing payments
landing.body: Recurring tuition that collects itself, skill badges parents actually look forward to, and a schedule your coaches can run from the pool deck.

organization.createBody: Pick the school you work with, or create a new one. Parents do not need one — you reach your children through the family portal.

families.heading: Families
families.intro: Each family is one household: its contacts, its swimmers, and later its billing.
families.deleteWarning: Deleting a family also deletes its guardians and swimmers. This cannot be undone.
families.counts: {guardians, plural, =0 {No guardians} one {# guardian} other {# guardians}} · {students, plural, =0 {no swimmers} one {# swimmer} other {# swimmers}}
families.noStudents: No swimmers in this family yet.
families.emptyBody: Add the first household. You will attach its guardians and swimmers from the family page.
families.emptyBodyReadOnly: No families have been added yet. An owner or administrator can add them.

students.medicalNotesPlaceholder: What a coach needs to know at the poolside
students.medicalNotesHint: Keep this to what a coach must know at the poolside — an allergy, asthma. It is health data about a child: record the minimum, not a medical file.

dashboard.heading: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Your school is connected and isolated. Classes, families and billing arrive in the next milestones.
dashboard.reviewHeading: {count, plural, one {# enrolment to review} other {# enrolments to review}}
dashboard.reviewBody: Families enrol their children themselves. Nothing here has been reviewed yet — a row leaves this list when you act on it, never because time passed.

curriculum.heading: Curriculum
curriculum.intro: Programs hold levels, levels hold skills. This is what coaches will tick off at the pool, and what turns into badges on a swimmer's profile.
curriculum.emptyBody: Start with a program — most schools begin with one called “Learn to Swim” — then add its levels and the skills each level requires.
curriculum.emptyBodyReadOnly: No programs have been created yet. An owner or administrator can add them.

locations.heading: Locations
locations.intro: The pools and sites where your classes take place.
locations.name: Location name
locations.emptyBody: Add the pools where your classes take place. You will assign classes to them from the schedule.
locations.emptyBodyReadOnly: No locations have been added yet. An owner or administrator can add them.

staff.heading: Staff
staff.intro: Who works at your school, and what each person is allowed to do.
staff.inviteHint: They receive an email invitation. Their account appears here once they accept and sign in for the first time.

actionErrors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
actionErrors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
actionErrors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
actionErrors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

errors.notFoundBody: This page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
errors.genericBody: The error has been recorded. Try again in a moment.

terms.heading: Terms
terms.intro: A term is a teaching period: a season, a school trimester, a summer course. Classes belong to one.
terms.name: Term name
terms.classCount: {count, plural, =0 {No classes} one {# class} other {# classes}}
terms.deleteWarning: Deleting a term also deletes its classes and their sessions. This cannot be undone.
terms.emptyBody: Create a term first — classes are scheduled inside one, and its dates decide which sessions get generated.
terms.emptyBodyReadOnly: No terms have been created yet. An owner or administrator can add them.

schedule.heading: Schedule
schedule.intro: Recurring classes, laid out week by week. Times are the school's local time.
schedule.title: Class name
schedule.occurrenceCount: {count, plural, =0 {no sessions} one {# session} other {# sessions}}
schedule.regenerateNote: Generating adds the missing dates and removes only future, untouched ones. Past sessions and cancellations are kept — they record what happened, or what someone decided.
schedule.missingPrerequisites: Add at least one level and one location before scheduling classes.
schedule.timezoneNote: Times are entered in the school's time zone ({timezone}) and stay there — including across daylight-saving changes.
schedule.waitlistHeading: {count, plural, one {# on the waiting list} other {# on the waiting list}}
schedule.waitlistNote: Rank follows the order people joined. Promoting the first moves everyone else up on their own — no numbering to maintain.
schedule.enrollNote: If the class is full, the swimmer joins the waiting list instead. The seat count is checked under a lock, so two people enrolling at the same moment cannot both take the last place.

actionReasons.classFull: This class is full ({taken}/{capacity}) — free a place before giving one.
actionReasons.alreadyEnrolled: This swimmer is already enrolled or on the waiting list for this class.
actionReasons.notWaitlisted: This enrolment is not on the waiting list.
actionReasons.notInThisSchool: That record no longer exists, or does not belong to this school.
actionReasons.termDatesReversed: The end date comes before the start date.
actionReasons.instructorNotActive: That instructor is not an active member of this school.
actionReasons.programInUse: This program is used by classes on the schedule. Delete those classes first.
actionReasons.levelInUse: This level is used by classes on the schedule. Delete those classes first.
actionReasons.locationInUse: This location is used by classes on the schedule. Delete those classes first.
actionReasons.lastOwner: This school would be left without an owner. Give someone else the owner role first.
actionReasons.cannotEditSelf: You cannot change your own access. Ask another owner or administrator.
actionReasons.emailInvalid: That email address does not look valid.
actionReasons.invitationRejected: This address has already been invited, or already belongs to the school.
actionReasons.tooManyOccurrences: This term would create {count} sessions, above the limit of {limit}. Check its dates.
actionReasons.stripeNotConfigured: Billing is not set up on this installation yet.
actionReasons.stripeNotConnected: Connect your school's Stripe account first.
actionReasons.planIsOneOff: This rate is billed per term, so it cannot be subscribed to. Issue an invoice for it instead.
actionReasons.planIsRecurring: This rate is a subscription, so it cannot be issued as a one-off invoice. Subscribe the family instead.
actionReasons.familyHasNoEmail: Stripe has no email address for this family, so it cannot send them the invoice. Add one on the family record.
actionReasons.familyNotBilledYet: Nothing has been charged to this family yet, so they have no payment record to manage. Subscribe them or issue an invoice first.

today.heading: Today at the pool
today.intro: Every session running today. Tap once per swimmer — taps are saved even if the network drops.
today.noSessionsBody: Nothing is scheduled for {date} — or the sessions have been cancelled.
today.offlinePending: {count, plural, one {Offline — # change waiting} other {Offline — # changes waiting}}. They will be sent when the network returns; you can keep marking.
today.noLevel: No level assigned yet — nothing to tick off.

badges.noCurriculum: No levels have been set up yet. Add programs and levels from the curriculum.

billing.heading: Billing
billing.intro: Connect your school's Stripe account. Tuition goes straight to you — BadgeLane never holds your money.
billing.notConfiguredBody: This installation has no Stripe keys configured. Add them to enable billing.
billing.notStartedBody: Connect a Stripe account to start collecting tuition. Stripe will ask for your bank and identity details on their own secure pages.
billing.incompleteBody: Stripe still needs some details before your school can take payments. Pick up where you left off.
billing.readyBody: Your Stripe account is connected and can accept payments.
billing.merchantNote: Your school is the merchant of record: tuition is paid to your Stripe account, and BadgeLane takes no cut of it. Card details never touch our servers.
billing.noPlans: No plan yet. Create one to start subscribing families.
billing.checkoutNote: Opens Stripe's hosted payment page. Card details are entered there, on Stripe's own domain — they never reach our servers. Automatic sending of this link to families comes with payment reminders.
billing.mirrorNote: Subscriptions and invoices are a mirror of Stripe, which holds the truth. Nothing here is edited by BadgeLane — it is refreshed from Stripe whenever something changes.
billing.issueInvoiceNote: Creates a one-off Stripe invoice due in {days} days, with its own payment page. Unlike a subscription it never renews, so there is no end date to remember.
billing.outstandingSummary: {count, plural, one {# unpaid invoice} other {# unpaid invoices}} — {total} to collect.
billing.dunningNote: Stripe chases these on your behalf: it retries failed card payments and emails families reminders before and after the due date, from your school's Stripe account. This list is here so you do not have to open Stripe to see where things stand.
billing.portalNote: Opens Stripe's hosted portal for that family, where a parent replaces an expired card and sees their invoices. Card details are handled by Stripe — neither your school nor BadgeLane ever sees them. The link is single-use and short-lived, so open it with the parent rather than sending it ahead.

portal.heading: My children
portal.noChildrenHeading: No children on this record yet
portal.noChildrenBody: Your school has not added any swimmers to your household yet. Get in touch with them and they will appear here.
portal.noFamilyHeading: No family linked to this address
portal.noFamilyBody: We link you to your children through the email address your school holds for you, once that address is verified. Check that you signed in with the address your school has, and that you confirmed it.
portal.noEnrollments: No classes yet. Pick one below and your child is in.
portal.seatsLeft: {left, plural, =0 {full — waiting list} one {# place left} other {# places left}}
portal.enrolNote: Places shown are indicative. If the class fills up before you tap, your child joins the waiting list rather than getting an error — nobody is ever squeezed into a full pool.
portal.billingNotConfigured: Your school has not set up billing for your household yet. Nothing to pay here for now.
